message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, how long does the reader wait between her hesitation and her request to reexamine the data, and is that delay doing useful work? What in your latest draft supports your judgment, and what remains uncertain? Why would further thinking earn its time over an informative writing attempt now; conversely, which unresolved decision would make waiting more valuable? What comparison would settle where to spend your attention? Can you briefly name your chosen next step and carry it out in English?
speaker: Astra
